configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: export API_PORT="${PORT:-4455}"; echo "$API_PORT" > apps/api/var/dev-api-port; KPI_AUTO_CALCULATION_INTERVAL_MINUTES=0 exec npm --prefix apps/api run dev

configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: API_PORT_IN_USE=$(cat apps/api/var/dev-api-port 2>/dev/null || echo 4455); WEB_PORT="${PORT:-5182}" VITE_API_BASE_URL="http://localhost:$API_PORT_IN_USE" exec npm --prefix apps/web run dev
